_note: Every clinical cutoff the plan uses. verified=false prints a PROPOSED banner on every plan. logic_verified covers the template logic that is NOT a number here (the likelihood point weights and bands, the prep rules, the four complexity triggers, the Heart Team factor rules, the stage assignment, Labs' eGFR-under-30 rule); the chair sets each flag only after checking.
status_text: PROPOSED values, not yet verified by the chair
contrast_ratio_basis: The published ratios use creatinine clearance, not eGFR (docs/EVIDENCE.md E1, E2): risk was flat below 2 and rose above 3 (Gurm 2011) and 3.7 was a discriminating cutoff (Laskey 2007). The plan shows both the eGFR ratio and, when age, sex, weight and creatinine are in the packet, a Cockcroft-Gault ratio, and applies the cutoffs to the higher. No guideline sets a limit; the chair confirms the basis.

likelihood._note: Illustrative, PROPOSED rule for the indeterminate (pre-cath) pathway. The weights are the author's, not derived from data. Points are added; the band is a label, never a probability.
likelihood._evidence: Inputs follow CAD-RADS 2.0 and the chest pain guidelines (E5, E6, E13); the point weights are a proposed heuristic (E14).

prep._note: PROPOSED prep rules: when a branch is staged and which device questions the plan puts to the chair. Questions only, never a choice of device. The chair verifies.
prep._support_note: 35% is a trial-population heuristic; the 2015 SCAI/ACC consensus gives no EF cutoff (E10), and a later position statement is not yet read.

heart_team._note: Published Heart Team factors (docs/EVIDENCE.md E7, E8): left main disease; multivessel disease with EF at or below this value. SYNTAX is not computed.

sources: docs/EVIDENCE.md (E1 to E16). Primary text read for the 2024 ESC guideline only; the rest from secondary summaries, retrieved 2026-11-04; the chair verifies each row
